messages:
mike_ops: Heads-up — EU staging flagged 12 x H200 arrivals with firmware rev mismatch. Vendor can do full replace in ~10-14d or offer a partial air-replace of 4 units in 48-72h with extra freight. PO PO-8472. Need a quick decision on waterfall: air now + RMA for remaining, or wait for full batch. :thinking:

olivia_procure: What's the uplift on air? need rough numbers to approve.

jordan_logistics: Carrier quoted €12.5k for 4 units D2D (includes fast customs handling). Can consolidate AWB and labels. ETA 48h if we sign today.

anya_sre: Impact note — those 12 were scheduled for eu-west training cluster this cycle. If we only get 4, batch capacity drops ~40%. We can scramble lower-priority jobs but batch queue latency will increase.

olivia_procure: Vendor also offered a partial warranty swap: they cover return freight only if we accept their AWB and label flow. Otherwise they bill return.

jordan_logistics: Also flagged: serials on replacements are from a different batch; customs may request a manifest and end-user certificates. I can prep docs if procurement greenlights air.

mike_ops: Summarize options: A) Approve air-replace 4 units now (charge to project), open RMA for remaining 8 with depot turnaround ~12d. B) Decline air, wait full 10-14d with no uplift. Leaning A for critical training runs. Need finance sign-off.

olivia_procure: Ballpark uplift per unit? I can ask finance faster if I have a number.

jordan_logistics: Rough math: ~€3k/unit uplift incl insurance + €500 AWB handling → ~€13.5k total for 4 units (matches carrier quote).

anya_sre: If we go A, can we request vendor to pre-flash the compatible software image so staging doesn't need rework? avoids repeated firmware churn.

rma_bot: RMA update: Case RMA-2023-551 created for PO-8472. Return labels pending. If air-replace selected, confirm carrier code MX-EXP080 on the PO.

mike_ops: Provisional approve A pending finance. @olivia_procure please ping @finance to release up to €14k. :point_up:

olivia_procure: Pinged finance for provisional uplift. Also requested vendor serial-range manifest and customs cert. CC @jordan_logistics.

jordan_logistics: I'll draft AWB and CCI manifest now. Pickup window proposed 09:00-12:00 CET if approved.

olivia_procure: Finance gave provisional ok for up to €14k. Proceed with air-replace. Mike, add a short note to the ticket: 'air-approve'.

mike_ops: Note added to ticket: "air-approve — proceed with MX-EXP080, finance provisional OK." rma_bot — please attach AWB when it's available. :white_check_mark:

rma_bot: AWB MX-EXP080-442 attached to RMA-2023-551. Track: https://trk.example/EXP080/442

jordan_logistics: AWB and manifest uploaded to the ticket, customs cert attached. Scheduling pickup this afternoon. :shipit:
